title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026’s biggest stage features leaders from Amazon, Replit, Tether, with much more to come
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: The Disrupt Stage is where many of the biggest conversations in technology happen, with a legacy that stretches back for more than a decade.
body:
## Exciting Lineup at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
The Disrupt Stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 is set to feature prominent leaders from top companies, including Amazon, Replit, and Tether. This year's event will focus on the challenges of building, funding, and scaling in the age of AI. Attendees will have the opportunity to hear from experts such as Panos Panay, Amjad Masad, and Paolo Ardoino, who will share their insights on the future of software, infrastructure, finance, security, and computing.

## Exploring the Future of Technology
The conference will delve into the impact of AI on the technology industry, exploring how it is transforming the way we interact with devices and services. With a legacy of hosting influential figures, the Disrupt Stage will provide a platform for founders, investors, and technologists to discuss the latest trends and innovations. The event will offer practical solutions and real-world examples, rather than speculative predictions, making it a valuable experience for attendees.

## Why It Matters
TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 is a must-attend event for developers and researchers who want to stay ahead of the curve in the rapidly evolving AI landscape. The conference will provide a unique opportunity to learn from industry leaders, network with peers, and gain insights into the latest technologies and innovations. With a limited time offer to save up to $300 on ticket prices, attendees are encouraged to act quickly to secure their spot at this prestigious event.
